description: This file defines the 'MinimumVersion' class, which is a strategy for selecting the lowest compatible version in the Orleans framework. It includes a singleton instance and is part of the Orleans.Versions.Selector namespace.

classes.name: MinimumVersion
classes.description: A sealed class implementing a version selection strategy that always chooses the lowest compatible version.

methods.name: Singleton
methods.description: A static property providing access to the singleton instance of the MinimumVersion class.
